gl:definition.gl:content: edge visibility arrangement in which information concealed by a blind edge (concept dpp-0136) is deposited with a threshold trustee and released only through a disclosure ceremony — court, regulator or consent

gl:notes.gl:content: The installation schema records escrow as none or trustee, with declared audiences.
An escrow envelope under a threshold trustee may optionally accompany a proof of binding (concept dpp-0138), preserving verifiability while full disclosure remains ceremonial.
